tagline: Hide sensitive data in screenshots before you share them.
empty.title: Drop a screenshot here
empty.hint: Or paste with {paste}, or open a file. SafeShot looks for CPF, phone numbers, e-mail, Pix keys and more on your own computer.
empty.brazil: Built for Brazilian data: CPF, CNPJ (including the alphanumeric one), RG, Pix key, license plate, CEP, area code.
drop.title: Drop the image here
drop.error: I couldn't open this file. Use PNG, JPG, WEBP, BMP, GIF or HEIC (macOS only).
paste.empty: There is no image on the clipboard.
ocr.reading: Reading the text in the image…
ocr.failed: I couldn't read the text in this image. You can still mark areas by hand.
sidebar.title: Data found
sidebar.nothing: I found no sensitive data. Check the image and mark anything missing by hand.
tool.showOriginal: Hold Alt to see the original
bar.label: Bar color
bar.whyBody: Blur and pixelation spread the pixels of the original text, and some tools can recover part of them. A solid bar replaces the pixels with a single color, so there is nothing left to recover.
toast.exportFailed: I couldn't export the image. Nothing was written.
toast.verifyFailed: The check found uncovered areas in the exported image. Nothing was delivered.
toast.saveRefused: I can't overwrite the original image. Pick another name.
notice.review: SafeShot helps, but check the image before you send it.

settings.termsHelp: Names, companies or words you never want to show. They stay on this computer only. Ignores case and accents and tolerates one reading mistake in long words.
